The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to use a water immiscible, nonvolatile, nonflammable ionic liquid for liquid-liquid microex- traction and subsequent direct injection into a capillary for CE analysis.
ionic liquids can be used as an extractant for liquid phase microextractions and the extracted species can be directly injected into a CE system.

the ionic liquid is not only a useful extraction solvent, but also a useful injection solvent, as it is not miscible with aqueous electrolytes and can be injected directly into CE without the need for any further dilution.
